Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed that acceleration remains constant at 9.8 m/s² downward after the chute opens. In reality, when the parachute opens, the air resistance (drag) force increases dramatically, creating a large upward acceleration that opposes the downward motion. This causes the magnitude of the net acceleration to change significantly (becoming negative relative to the downward positive direction, or simply opposing the velocity). The planner failed to account for the change in forces (specifically the increase in drag) resulting from the chute opening, leading to the wrong conclusion that acceleration stays the same.
